thread:
Mia Chen (CS): Heads-up — Hummingbird Legal is blocked on EU onboarding because their corporate proxy is NATting requests from a small set of IP ranges. They need those ranges allowlisted + a short-term QPS bump for demo traffic. Renewal call in 9 days, so this is high priority.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): Can you drop the exact IP ranges and the QPS you want? Also any data residency pinning requirements?
Mia Chen (CS): Yep. IPs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/29. They want EU region pinned (eu-west-1) and a temporary increase from 20 QPS to 80 QPS for 72h around their partner demo. Data residency: customer data must stay in EU — they're using Private routing to EU.
Asha Patel (Onboard): Adding context — they failed the demo earlier today when we hit the default burst protection. This is causing customer anxiety. If we can't guarantee the demo, renewal risk increases. Can we do an autorevoke after 72h?
Karl Ng (NetEng): We can add those prefixes to the edge allowlist and pin routing to eu-west-1. Need a maint window? Should be low-risk. We'll schedule immediate apply with an expiry tag.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): Also watch KV cache locality — pinning + proxy NAT may still send some control-plane callbacks to other regions if metadata isn't pinned. I'll set model routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for that project id.
Mia Chen (CS): Proposed config snippet for ops team (expiry uses RFC3339):
```
allowlist:
  - cidr: "203.0.113.0/28"
    note: "Hummingbird Legal demo temporary"
  - cidr: "198.51.100.32/29"
    note: "Hummingbird Legal demo temporary"
allowlist-expires: "2026-03-25T18:30:00Z"
rate_limits:
  project_id: "hummingbird-legal-prod"
  qps: 80
  duration: "72h"
region_pin: "eu-west-1"
```
Asha Patel (Onboard): That looks good. Can ops add a revocation job and a slack reminder 24h before expiry?
Karl Ng (NetEng): Yep. I'll create the allowlist change and tag it with `autorevoke: true`. Ops will handle the reminder.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4521 — "Hummingbird Legal: EU allowlist + 72h QPS bump". Assignees: Karl Ng, Jorge Alvarez. ETA: 15m.
Jorge Alvarez (SE): Quick note on capacity — autoscaler will handle CPU/GPU autoscale, but token-level concurrency spikes mean we should set a soft throttle at 120 QPS as safety. We asked backend to apply a soft cap: `soft_limit: 120` (not enforced unless we hit infra constraints).
Mia Chen (CS): Please confirm once allowlist applied so I can tell the customer. Also flag renewal team to mention resolved in renewal playbook.
Karl Ng (NetEng): Applied and verified from EU edge (tested curl with source IP simulated). Firewall logs show accepted from both ranges. `allowlist-expires` tag set and revocation job queued. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: CS-4521 updated: status -> done. Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z.
Asha Patel (Onboard): Customer confirmed demo succeeded. They appreciated the fast turnaround. Noted for renewal — mark as "escalation mitigated" in CRM.
Mia Chen (CS): Great job everyone — lowered renewal risk. I'll follow up with a short post-demo survey to capture feedback about latency and regional behavior. :thumbsup:
